runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game sc_18s11 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-95/sc-light-rope-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Each selection is chosen with Up and started and stopped with Enter; a selection left flashing can still toggle as the next one is chosen.

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: LIGHT ROPE TEST / OFF / USE +/- TO TEST
diagnostic_snapshots.label: Enter (start T.18 LIGHT ROPE)

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: LIGHT ROPE TEST / LIGHT ROPE 1 / PRESS "ENTER" TO FLASH
diagnostic_snapshots.label: Up 1 (next rope selection)

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: LIGHT ROPE TEST / LIGHT ROPE 2 / PRESS "ENTER" TO FLASH
diagnostic_snapshots.label: Up 2 (next rope selection)

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: LIGHT ROPE TEST / BOTH / PRESS "ENTER" TO FLASH
diagnostic_snapshots.label: Up 3 (next rope selection)

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: LIGHT ROPE TEST / BOTH / PRESS "ENTER" STOP FLASHING
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.18 flashing 3 frame 0

named_action_observations.label: T.18 LIGHT ROPE TEST selects LIGHT ROPE 1, LIGHT ROPE 2 and BOTH with Up and flashes them: public 23 is light rope 1, public 24 light rope 2, and BOTH flashes 23 and 24

raw_runs.name: sc_18s11-light-rope-test
raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, so the ROM performed its own factory reset before the scenario left the message loop with Escape

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
